description: Make clawctl ready for usage: review and harden the bash MVP's transport choices, define a versioned JSON-schema tool envelope, then ship a typed Go binary with an MCP server frontend so Claude Code, Codex, and other local LLMs can call openclaw agents as typed tools.

userStories.title: Write transport decision matrix doc
userStories.description: As a contributor, I want a written matrix of which transport (HTTP API, SSH, local CLI) is correct for which clawctl operation, so future subcommands don't get implemented over the wrong transport.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/transport-decisions.md exists
Matrix has one row per existing subcommand: health, models, msg, stream, raw, cli, verify, trace
Each row lists: operation, chosen transport, rationale, alternative considered, exit-code contract
Each row cites the failure mode the chosen transport avoids
Markdown lints clean

userStories.title: Define v1 JSON-schema tool envelope
userStories.description: As a local LLM caller, I need a typed envelope shape so I can register openclaw agents as tools and reason structurally about their outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: schemas/envelope.v1.json defines ToolRequest, ToolResponse, ToolStreamChunk, ToolError
Envelope carries: agent, session_id?, traceparent, input, tool_choice?, redactions[], usage, finish_reason, envelope_version: '1'
ToolError.code is an enum mapping gateway HTTP errors (transport.connection_refused, gateway.rate_limited, agent.unknown, redaction.applied, etc.)
Schema validates with a standard JSON Schema validator (e.g. ajv) against an empty fixture
docs/envelope.md documents versioning policy (additive within v1; breaking bumps to v2)
